gloss: backward bend; reverse warp; back bow

definitions.gloss: backward bend; reverse warp; back bow
definitions.explanation: A bending or warping in the opposite direction from what is expected or normal. Used in construction, woodworking, and manufacturing to describe material that curves the wrong way, as well as in physical contexts to describe bending the body backward.

examples.japanese: {板|いた}に{逆反|ぎゃくぞ}りが{出|で}た。
examples.english: The board developed a reverse warp.

examples.japanese: {乾燥|かんそう}が{進|すす}むと{木材|もくざい}に{逆反|ぎゃくぞ}りが{起|お}こりやすい。
examples.english: As drying progresses, reverse warping is more likely to occur in lumber.

examples.japanese: {体操|たいそう}{選手|せんしゅ}は{見事|みごと}な{逆反|ぎゃくぞ}りの{姿勢|しせい}を{決|き}めた。
examples.english: The gymnast struck an impressive backward-arching pose.

notes:
Composed of {逆|ぎゃく} (reverse, opposite) and {反|そ}り (warp, bend, curve). The {反|そ}り undergoes rendaku (voicing) to become ぞり. This term is used across several domains: in woodworking and construction, it describes unwanted warping of materials in the wrong direction; in physical activity, it describes arching the body backward.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆反|ぎゃくぞ}りを{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent reverse warping
- {逆反|ぎゃくぞ}りが{生|しょう}じる: reverse warping occurs
- {逆反|ぎゃくぞ}りの{修正|しゅうせい}: correction of reverse warp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {反|そ}り: warp, bend — warping in any direction
- {反|そ}り{返|かえ}り: arching backward — specifically the physical motion of bending back
- {歪|ゆが}み: distortion, warping — a broader term for any deformation
